{"diagnosis":"The batch 14 redelivery (ingest 05:00) re-sent rows with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, and the cast to TIMESTAMP fails on them. 1768716104000 ms is exactly 2026-01-18 06:01:44 UTC, the same as the 02:00 copy of txn 904477. The redelivered rows duplicate existing txn_ids: 5128 rows against 4802 distinct ids. The fix parses epoch-ms values and keeps one row per txn_id, preferring the earliest ingest.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
         customer_id,
         CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
         CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts,
         ingest_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM parsed
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, txn_ts) = 1;"}}
